title: Network Anomaly Event
description: Strict schema definition for network flow anomalies identified by the local Isolation Forest agent.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 formatted timestamp of when the anomalous network event originated.

src_ip.description: The IP address of the communication source.

dst_ip.description: The IP address of the communication destination.

protocol.description: The normalized network or transport protocol identified during flow extraction.

byte_count.description: Total bytes transferred in the specific payload or flow window. Cannot be negative.

threat_score.description: Normalized anomaly score derived from the Scikit-learn Isolation Forest model. 0 represents benign traffic; 100 represents highest statistical confidence of an anomaly.

anomaly_flag.description: A discrete boolean flag denoting whether the threat_score breached the predefined dynamic threshold for immediate triage.

suggested_action.description: The localized recommendation formulated by the edge agent for ingestion by the central Policy Decision Point.
